Independent scoring panel member 1. Evaluate five completed software runs under workflow-evaluation/runs/*-base-001 (exclude baseline-launches.json). Read workflow-evaluation/RUBRIC.md and judge-prompts/judge-1.txt; apply that frozen scoring prompt to EACH run, all 20 criteria with locators, sum and gate. Each run contains transcript/, fixture-before/, fixture-after/ and one capture-* directory with acceptance.json, expected-template.json, verification JSON, diff, worker-final and index. Read complete substantive transcripts and changes. Feature additionally has search-red.txt recovered by parent post-run, not worker-read transcript evidence; assess chronology from transcript. Do NOT read other judges, source improvement proposals, design review/audit conclusions, previous scores or goal target. This is imperfectly blinded: directory labels reveal baseline; disregard condition labels and score evidence only. Do not execute worker code or edit any files. No proposals yet. Return five complete JSON ballots in final response; use concise rationales and exact evidence locators. All scores must be supported. No credit from boxes alone; quality and actual assigned guidance adherence are distinct. Same-model independent sessions are used; no provider diversity claimed.
